Let's design the header structure:
```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Calendar, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@/components/breadcrumbs';
import { SidebarTrigger } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import type { BreadcrumbItem as BreadcrumbItemType, SharedData } from '@/types';

export function AppSidebarHeader({
    breadcrumbs = [],
}: {
    breadcrumbs?: BreadcrumbItemType[];
}) {
    const { auth } = usePage<SharedData>().props;
    const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState('');

    useEffect(() => {
        const formatIndonesianDate = () => {
            const days = ['Minggu', 'Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu'];
            const months = [
                'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
                'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'
            ];
            const now = new Date();
            const dayName = days[now.getDay()];
            const date = now.getDate();
            const monthName = months[now.getMonth()];
            const year = now.getFullYear();
            return `${dayName}, ${date} ${monthName} ${year}`;
        };
        setCurrentTime(formatIndonesianDate());
    }, []);

    return (
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-sidebar-border/30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md px-6 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out md:px-6">
            {/* Left Section */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <SidebarTrigger className="h-9 w-9 rounded-lg border border-sidebar-border/60 bg-sidebar/30 transition-transform duration-150 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95" />
                <div className="h-4 w-[1px] bg-sidebar-border/50" />
                <Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs={breadcrumbs} />
            </div>

            {/* Right Section - Premium Admin Widgets */}
            <div className="hidden items-center gap-4 sm:flex">
                {/* Date Widget */}
                {currentTime && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-sidebar-border/50 bg-sidebar/20 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground shadow-xs">
                        <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                        <span>{currentTime}</span>
                    </div>
                )}

                {/* Session Status Widget */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/5 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-400 shadow-xs">
                    <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                        <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75"></span>
                        <span className="relative inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
                    </span>
                    <span>Admin Active</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </header>
    );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import {
    Breadcrumb,
    BreadcrumbItem,
    BreadcrumbLink,
    BreadcrumbList,
    BreadcrumbPage,
    BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb';
import type { BreadcrumbItem as BreadcrumbItemType } from '@/types';

export function Breadcrumbs({
    breadcrumbs,
}: {
    breadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItemType[];
}) {
    return (
        <>
            {breadcrumbs.length > 0 && (
                <Breadcrumb>
                    <BreadcrumbList>
                        {breadcrumbs.map((item, index) => {
                            const isLast = index === breadcrumbs.length - 1;

                            return (
                                <Fragment key={index}>
                                    <BreadcrumbItem>
                                        {isLast ? (
                                            <BreadcrumbPage>
                                                {item.title}
                                            </BreadcrumbPage>
                                        ) : (
                                            <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
                                                <Link href={item.href}>
                                                    {item.title}
                                                </Link>
                                            </BreadcrumbLink>
                                        )}
                                    </BreadcrumbItem>
                                    {!isLast && <BreadcrumbSeparator />}
                                </Fragment>
                            );
                        })}
                    </BreadcrumbList>
                </Breadcrumb>
            )}
        </>
    );
}
```

```tsx
import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import { LayoutGrid } from 'lucide-react';
import {
    Breadcrumb,
    BreadcrumbItem,
    BreadcrumbLink,
    BreadcrumbList,
    BreadcrumbPage,
    BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb';
import type { BreadcrumbItem as BreadcrumbItemType } from '@/types';

export function Breadcrumbs({
    breadcrumbs,
}: {
    breadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItemType[];
}) {
    return (
        <>
            {breadcrumbs.length > 0 && (
                <Breadcrumb>
                    <BreadcrumbList className="flex items-center gap-1.5 md:gap-2">
                        {/* Always show a tiny home/dashboard icon at the start if there's a hierarchy, or just general styling */}
                        <BreadcrumbItem>
                            <Link 
                                href="/admin" 
                                className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1.5 text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground"
                                title="Dashboard Ringkasan Admin"
                            >
                                <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4" />
```

```powershell
$tempDir = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ".\temp-runtime" -Force

Copy-Item -Path ".\public\favicon.ico" -Destination "$pubHtml\favicon.ico" -Force

# Use Compress-Archive to zip the public_html folder itself.
# To ensure the top-level folder inside ZIP is public_html, we target $tempDir\public_html (or use -Path "$tempDir\public_html" -DestinationPath $zipPath)
Compress-Archive -Path "$tempDir\public_html" -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force

# Clean up temp directory
Remove-Item -Path $tempDir -Recurse -Force
```

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const readline = require('readline');

const transcriptPath = 'C:\\Users\\ASUS S406\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\2b6ada63-a969-45cb-8b64-d9d1ac3c9a1c\\.system_generated\\logs\\transcript.jsonl';
const outputPath = 'D:\\ResponSetara\\web-app\\log.md';

const stream = fs.createReadStream(transcriptPath);
const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: stream,
    crlfDelay: Infinity
});

let conversation = [];

rl.on('line', (line) => {
    if (!line.trim()) return;
    try {
        const step = JSON.parse(line);
        if (step.type === 'USER_INPUT') {
            let content = step.content || '';
            content = content.replace(/<USER_REQUEST>/g, '').replace(/<\/USER_REQUEST>/g, '').trim();
            conversation.push({ role: 'USER', content });
        } else if (step.type === 'PLANNER_RESPONSE' || step.type === 'MODEL') {
            let content = step.content || '';
            content = content.trim();
            
            // Get any tool summary
            let tools = [];
            if (step.tool_calls && step.tool_calls.length > 0) {
                step.tool_calls.forEach(tc => {
                    let desc = tc.name;
                    if (tc.args && tc.args.toolAction) {
                        desc = tc.args.toolAction.replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
                    } else if (tc.args && tc.args.CommandLine) {
                        desc = `Ran command: ${tc.args.CommandLine.replace(/^"|"$/g, '')}`;
                    }
                    tools.push(`* ${desc}`);
                });
            }
            
            conversation.push({ role: 'ANTIGRAVITY', content, tools });
        }
    } catch (e) {}
});

rl.on('close', () => {
    // Process conversation to combine consecutive roles and build the markdown
    let processed = [];
    let current = null;
    
    conversation.forEach(item => {
        if (!current) {
            current = { role: item.role, content: item.content, tools: item.tools || [] };
        } else if (current.role === item.role) {
            // merge consecutive
            current.content += '\n\n' + item.content;
            if (item.tools) {
                current.tools = current.tools.concat(item.tools);
            }
        } else {
            processed.push(current);
            current = { role: item.role, content: item.content, tools: item.tools || [] };
        }
    });
    if (current) {
        processed.push(current);
    }
    
    // Now write the file

    outputLines.push('');
    outputLines.push('## Project Information');
    outputLines.push('');
    outputLines.push('- Project: ResponSetara');
    outputLines.push('- Competition: BITSMIKRO Innovative Vibecode 2026');
    outputLines.push('- AI Coding Assistant: Antigravity');
    outputLines.push('- Production: https://afnicode.me');
    outputLines.push('- Workspace: D:\\ResponSetara\\web-app');
    outputLines.push('');
    outputLines.push('---');
    outputLines.push('');
    outputLines.push('# Conversation Transcript');
    outputLines.push('');
    
    processed.forEach(item => {
        let content = item.content.trim();
        // Remove repetitive user instructions metadata if present
        content = sanitizeSecrets(content);
        
        if (item.role === 'USER') {
            outputLines.push('### USER');
            outputLines.push('');
            outputLines.push('```text');
            outputLines.push(content);
            outputLines.push('```');
            outputLines.push('');
        } else {
            outputLines.push('### ANTIGRAVITY');
            outputLines.push('');
            outputLines.push('```text');
            outputLines.push(content);
            if (item.tools && item.tools.length > 0) {
                const uniqueTools = [...new Set(item.tools)];
                outputLines.push('\n[Actions performed]\n' + uniqueTools.join('\n'));
            }
            outputLines.push('```');
            outputLines.push('');
        }
    });
    
    outputLines.push('# Final Project Status');
    outputLines.push('');
    outputLines.push('**Frontend:** Final');
    outputLines.push('**Deployment:** Online');
    outputLines.push('**Domain:** [https://afnicode.me](https://afnicode.me)');

    outputLines.push('**Admin CMS:** Aktif');
    outputLines.push('');
    
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, outputLines.join('\n'), 'utf8');
    console.log('Finished processing transcript.jsonl. Stored in ' + outputPath);
});

function sanitizeSecrets(text) {
    let clean = text;
    // Replace API keys
    clean = clean.replace(/AIzaSy[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}/g, '[REDACTED_GEMINI_API_KEY]');
    // Replace typical passwords
    clean = clean.replace(/(DB_PASSWORD|Supabase_password|APP_KEY)=[^\s&]+/gi, '$1=[REDACTED]');
    // Replace session/cookie tokens
    clean = clean.replace(/(session_token|cookie_token|xsrf-token)=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/gi, '$1=[REDACTED]');
    return clean;
}
